what: SHA-256 of every pre-registered test result, nanopublication draft, frozen exam file and key evidence artifact in this tree at the named commit.
whatThisProves: That these exact bytes existed no later than the moment GitHub received this release, which is a timestamp we cannot backdate. It does NOT retroactively prove any earlier claim about when a file was written: the in-repo commit order remains the only evidence for that, and the margins between pre-registration and first data retrieval are stated inside the records themselves, including the tightest at 2 seconds.
